enhancedRecommendations.name: Multicluster management & security at scale for Kubernetes
enhancedRecommendations.reasoning: Crowdstrike has significant multi-cloud investment, with large spends on AWS ($240K ACV) and GCP ($210K ACV). They are also heavy Kubernetes users and have an expired OpenShift subscription. For a security-focused company like Crowdstrike, managing and securing disparate Kubernetes clusters across multiple public clouds is a critical, complex challenge. This tactic directly addresses that high-level operational and security need which is not covered by a base platform.
enhancedRecommendations.discoveryReason: Multi-cloud spend (AWS, GCP) + Kubernetes usage + Security-focused customer DNA = Clear need for multi-cluster management and security (ACM).
